overview_description.description:
ChartHop is an information technology company that specializes in the fields of software development and management. ChartHop is designed to be used by the whole organization. This helps companies improve organizational health, drive alignment and accountability, and save time and money.

It was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in New York, United States.

about_short_description.short_description: ChartHop is an information technology company that specializes in the fields of software development and management.

product.name: ChartHop Core
product.description: A people data platform for workforce analytics, dashboards, organizational visualization, employee profiles, map views, calendars, and AI-powered insights.

product.name: Headcount Planning
product.description: A workforce planning module for modeling, approving, tracking, and forecasting headcount with real-time organizational and budget impact.

product.name: HRIS
product.description: A human resources information system that centralizes employee data, organizational structures, profiles, and people operations workflows without processing payroll.

product.name: Compensation
product.description: A compensation review module for configuring merit, promotion, and equity cycles while managing pay budgets, approvals, and compensation analysis.

product.name: Performance
product.description: A performance management module that connects reviews, goals, development conversations, and manager workflows in one people operations system.

product.name: Engagement
product.description: An employee engagement module for collecting sentiment data, analyzing organizational trends, and identifying areas for action across teams.
